_comment: Strings the W shell/python scripts put on a GRAPHICAL surface — desktop notifications and their action buttons — plus the w-info catalog's own chrome. Namespaced '<script>.<thing>'. Generated into /usr/share/w/i18n/<lang>.conf and read at runtime through /usr/lib/w/w-i18n-lib.sh (bash) or /usr/lib/w/w-i18n (anything else). The --help text of the w-* commands is NOT here — it is its own domain, i18n/help/<lang>/, see config-i18n.md §5a — and their runtime terminal output stays English for now (§5). w-info is the one deliberate exception on this side: its body IS the catalog, and every line of that catalog is a translated Info:, so an English frame around a Russian list would just look broken. Values may carry printf placeholders (%s, asserted to match across languages) and must not contain a real newline — the target is a key=value line format.

info.header.en: W Linux — available tools (run '<tool> help' for details):

info.none.en: No w-* tools with Info: descriptions found.
info.none.ru: Инструментов w-* с описанием Info: не найдено.

info.hint.en: Run 'w-<tool> help' on a specific tool for usage.

comfyui.starting_body.en: The generative engine is warming up — the browser will open when the port answers.
comfyui.starting_body.ru: Движок генерации запускается — браузер откроется, когда порт ответит.

comfyui.failed_body.en: See 'systemctl status comfyui' for the reason.

snapshot.body.en: Recovery boot — the system is read-only and changes outside /home are lost.
snapshot.body.ru: Загрузка для восстановления — система доступна только для чтения, изменения вне /home будут потеряны.
